name: Jekamja
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jekamja is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah. He was the son of Shallum and part of the royal lineage after David. His primary significance lies in maintaining the genealogical connection in Judah's royal line through the exile.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jekamja is mentioned as the son of Shallum in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, as part of the royal lineage after King David.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jekamja is part of the longer lineage from Judah through David, showing God's faithfulness in preserving the royal line through generations.

keyEvents.title: Shallum's Son in Jerahmeel's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jekamja belongs to Jerahmeel's branch of the tribe of Judah, and his father Shallum was the son of Sismai. This lineage connects him to a prominent branch of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Jerahmeel's Descendants Recorded
keyEvents.description: The recording of Jerahmeel's descendants, including Jekamja, shows the importance of preserving tribal identity and family history for the people of Israel.
